use bytes::Bytes;
use onc_rpc_xdr::{XdrDecode, XdrEncode};

pub const HANDLE_SIZE: i64 = 64;

pub type trace_id_t = u64;

pub type file_handle_t = Bytes;

pub type path_t = String;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct timestamp_t {
    pub seconds: u32,
    pub nseconds: u32,
}

impl XdrEncode for timestamp_t {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.seconds.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.nseconds.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for timestamp_t {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            seconds: <u32 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            nseconds: <u32 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(i32)]
pub enum status_t {
    STATUS_OK = 0,
    STATUS_NOENT = 2,
    STATUS_STALE = 116,
    STATUS_FAILED = 1001,
}

impl XdrEncode for status_t {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        (*self as i32).encode_xdr(output)
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for status_t {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match i32::decode_xdr(input)? {
            0 => Ok(Self::STATUS_OK),
            2 => Ok(Self::STATUS_NOENT),
            116 => Ok(Self::STATUS_STALE),
            1001 => Ok(Self::STATUS_FAILED),
            other => Err(onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError::InvalidEnum(other)),
        }
    }
}
